description: GEER - August 4, 2020 Beirut Port Explosion is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Paolo Zimmaro, University of Calabria (unical.it). This project contains GEER post-disaster reconnaissance data collected following the August 4, 2020 Beirut Port explosion. Coverage: Beirut (Lebanon). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Beirut Port explosion, post-disaster reconnaissance, structural damage, non-structural damage, facade damage. Published 2021-06-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
